title: Predictive Uncertainty for Neural CAE Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2609.25430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates can substantially accelerate computer-aided engineering (CAE) workflows, but their use in design requires uncertainty estimates that remain meaningful across varying geometries, spatial prediction fields, and engineering quantities of interest. We investigate how established uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches behave when adapted to geometry-conditioned neural surrogates. We compare one closed-form and two sampling-based approaches-a Gaussian process (GP)-based method, concrete Monte Carlo (MC) dropout, and deep ensembles-and evaluate them on three large, industry-relevant CAE datasets for external aerodynamics and crash dynamics.   We examine whether predicted uncertainties have credible magnitudes, identify locations with larger prediction errors, respond to unfamiliar inputs, and remain informative for derived engineering quantities. translated_title: 神经CAE代理模型的预测不确定性
translated_abstract: 神经代理模型能够大幅加速计算机辅助工程（CAE）工作流程，但要将其用于设计，就需要在不同几何形状、空间预测场和工程关注量之间保持有意义的不确定性估计。我们研究了将现有不确定性量化（UQ）方法适配到几何条件化神经代理模型时的表现。我们比较了一种闭式方法和两种基于采样的方法——基于高斯过程（GP）的方法、具体化蒙特卡洛（MC）dropout以及深度集成——并在三个大型、与工业相关的CAE数据集（涵盖外空气动力学和碰撞动力学）上对其进行评估。我们检验预测的不确定性是否具有可信的量级、能否识别预测误差较大的位置、能否对不熟悉的输入做出响应，以及对派生的工程量是否仍能提供有效信息。在所有三种方法均参与比较的DrivAerStar数据集上，每一……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将三种不确定性量化方法（基于高斯过程的方法、MC dropout和深度集成）适配于几何条件化的神经CAE代理模型，并在外空气动力学与碰撞动力学等大型工业数据集上系统评估其不确定性估计的可信性、对预测误差和陌生输入的敏感性以及对派生工程量的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts and compares three established uncertainty quantification approaches (GP-based method, concrete MC dropout, and deep ensembles) for geometry-conditioned neural CAE surrogates, evaluating on large industry-relevant aerodynamics and crash datasets whether the uncertainties remain credible, informative about prediction errors, responsive to unfamiliar inputs, and useful for derived engineering quantities.
